name: South West Coast Path
description_md:
This national waymarked hiking network trail covers a distance of 1034.7 km. The route is signposted as SWCP and involves 29514 m of ascent and 29516 m of descent.

It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 337 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes Exercise Tiger within 100 m, Saint Mary's Church within 100 m, and Public Buildings within 500 m.
